about: The deflect of Right Cut (katana.k_l1 parried), milestone-1 task 34: Parry1H01's right hit at its own speed, made two-handed by the lights' pass and aimed at the moment of contact (frame 2) so the blade crosses the attacker's just inside its tip, where the rules' contact is (the attacker's blade read on its contact frame), at 2.5 m, the lights' duelling distance.
